follow_ups.title: GetItemById and UpdateItemV1 return application/json for 400s documented as application/problem+json
follow_ups.reason: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> is sent as application/json while their ProducesResponseType annotations declare application/problem+json, so clients and the OpenAPI document disagree.

follow_ups.title: Remove the BUG-15 row from the testing/flows/ bugs table once that folder exists in this repository
follow_ups.reason: The story's acceptance criteria ask for it, but testing/flows/ and e2e/teststack/ordering-api.spec.ts are not in this dogfood copy.

follow_ups.title: Catalog facet counts ignore onlyAvailable
follow_ups.reason: GET /api/catalog/items/facets has no onlyAvailable parameter, so with 'In stock only' ticked the Brand/Type counts in the filter panel still count out-of-stock products and can disagree with the listed results.

follow_ups.title: HybridApp catalog does not support onlyAvailable
follow_ups.reason: src/HybridApp/Services/CatalogService.cs implements ICatalogService without the new overload; the interface default keeps it compiling but it ignores the filter.

follow_ups.title: HybridApp catalog ignores the onlyAvailable filter
follow_ups.reason: HybridApp's ICatalogService implementation inherits the default 5-arg overload that drops onlyAvailable, so the MAUI hybrid app has no in-stock filter; outside this subtask's owns (src/WebApp/**, src/WebAppComponents/**).

follow_ups.title: Catalog facet counts ignore the In stock only filter
follow_ups.reason: With In stock only ticked, the brand and type counts in CatalogSearch (GetCatalogFacets) still include out-of-stock products, so they can be higher than the number of products listed.

follow_ups.title: Pre-existing whitespace and charset issues in CatalogApi.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes flags lines 91 and 98 and the file encoding on main, which can fail a format check in CI.

follow_ups.title: Parse catalog page query parameters (page, brand, type) leniently
follow_ups.reason: A non-integer value for page, brand or type in the catalog URL makes SupplyParameterFromQuery throw and shows an error page.

follow_ups.title: Make facet counts respect onlyAvailable
follow_ups.reason: GET /api/catalog/items/facets ignores onlyAvailable, so brand and type counts overstate the listed items when In stock only is checked.
